title: 2020年9月四级真题 第1套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 The work-life balance is dead. By this, I'm not advocating that you should give up your pursuit of having a fulfilling career and a thriving personal life, and I'm definitely not saying that you have to give up one to have the other. I also acknowledge that we have a work-life problem, but I'm arguing that the concept of balance has never been helpful, because it's too limiting. You see, our language makes a difference, and how we refer to things matters because it affects our thinking and therefore our actions.

P2 At the minimum, most of us work because we want to be able to support ourselves, our families, and the people around us. In the ideal world, we're all doing work that we're proud of and that provides meaning and purpose to us. But even if your job doesn't give you shivers of joy each new day, working is a part of what each of us does and the contribution we make to society. When you separate work and life, it's a little bit harder to make that connection. But when you think of work as part of a full life and a complete experience, it becomes easier to see that success in one aspect often supports another.

P3 Losing your balance and falling isn't pleasant. A goal to balance suggests that things could quickly get off balance, and that causes terrible outcomes. It's more constructive to think of solutions that continue to evolve over shifts in life and work. Rather than falling or failing, you may have good days or better days or not-so-good days. These variations are normal, and it's more useful to think of life as something that is ever evolving and changing, rather than a high-risk enterprise where things could go wrong with one misstep.

P4 How we talk to ourselves matters, and how we talk about issues makes a difference. Let's bury "work-life balance" and think bigger and better about work-life fulfillment to do a little less balancing and a lot more living.

questions.q: What does the author suggest by saying "The work-life balance is dead"?
options: The hope of achieving a thriving life is impossible to realize.
The pursuit of a fulfilling career involves personal sacrifice.
The imbalance between work and life simply doesn't exist anymore
The concept of work-life balance contributes little to a fulfilling life.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干用 What does the author suggest by saying 的句式，直接询问作者说这句话想表达 什么，是典型的句意理解题。

【拆句】主干是 What does the author suggest，by 引导的方式状语 by saying "The work-life balance is dead" 修饰 suggest，引号内是宾语从句的内容，整体平铺直叙，无陷阱。 51. What does the author suggest by saying "The work-life balance is dead"? A) The hope of achieving a thriving life is impossible to realize. B) The pursuit of a fulfilling career involves personal sacrifice. C) The imbalance between work and life simply doesn't exist anymore D) The concept of work-life balance contributes little to a fulfilling life.

【定位】The work-life balance is dead. By this, I'm not advocating that you should give up your pursuit of having a fulfilling career and a thriving personal life, and I'm definitely not saying that you have to give up one to have the other. I also acknowledge that we have a work- life problem, but I'm arguing that the concept of balance has never been helpful, because it's too limiting. 「工作-生活平衡」这个说法已经死了。我说这话不是劝你放弃追求充实的事业和蓬勃的私 人生活，更不是说你必须放弃其一才能拥有另一个。我承认我们确实存在工作-生活问题， 但我主张「平衡」这个概念从来都没什么用，因为它把人框得太死。

【选项】A) 把对「概念」的否定偷换成对「目标」的否定 选项说「实现充实人生的希望根本不可能实现」，而作者明确否认了这种解读：I'm not advocating that you should give up your pursuit of having a fulfilling career and a thriving personal life——他根本没说目标做不到，只说「平衡」这个词不好用。 B) 无中生有 选项说追求充实事业需要「个人牺牲」，文中通篇没讨论过 sacrifice 或牺牲——作者只 是要换掉 balance 的提法，没说追求事业要牺牲生活。 C) 与原文相反 选项说工作和生活的失衡现象不再存在了，作者却紧接着承认 I also acknowledge that we have a work-life problem——他承认问题真实存在，只是反对 balance 这个概 念，与选项正相反。 D) ✓ 正确 the concept of balance has never been helpful ↔ The concept of work-life balance contributes little to a fulfilling life a fulfilling career and a thriving personal life ↔a fulfilling life The concept of work-life balance contributes little to a fulfilling life 用「贡献甚 微」换「从来没帮助」、用「充实人生」概括「事业加私生活」，正是定位句 the concept of balance has never been helpful 的同义改写。 作者关于我们使用语言说了什么? A) 它影响我们的思维和行为方式。 B) 它随着时间的流逝而变化。 C) 它反映了我们如何沟通。 D) 它因人而异。

questions.q: What does the author say about our use of language?
options: It impacts how we think and behave.
It changes with the passage of time.
It reflects how we communicate.
It differs from person to person.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author say about our use of language 直接问作者关于某具体对象 的明确表述，要求复述原文观点。 52. What does the author say about our use of language? A) It impacts how we think and behave. B) It changes with the passage of time. C) It reflects how we communicate. D) It differs from person to person.

【拆句】主干 What does the author say，about 介词短语 about our use of language 限定 say 的内容范围，句式简单。

【定位】You see, our language makes a difference, and how we refer to things matters because it affects our thinking and therefore our actions. 你看，我们的语言会造成不同，我们如何称呼事物很重要，因为它影响我们的思维，进而影 响我们的行动。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 it affects our thinking and therefore our actions ↔It impacts how we think and behave It impacts how we think and behave 同时覆盖「思维」和「行动」两个语义点，与定 位句中的因果链完全对应，是定位句的最简同义改写。 B) 无中生有 选项说语言「随时间推移而变化」，原文谈的是语言对思维的影响，从未讨论语言本身 的历时演变。 C) 偷换概念 选项说语言「反映」我们如何沟通，定位句说语言「影响」思维和行动——reflect（反 映）和 affect（影响）方向相反：一个是被动镜像，一个是主动塑造。 D) 无中生有 选项说语言「因人而异」，原文谈的是语言对所有人的共同效应（影响思维与行动）， 完全没讨论个体差异。 作者说在理想世界中我们做什么? A) 我们做改善家人和朋友生活的工作。 B) 我们做每天都给我们带来快乐的工作。 C) 我们做对社会有贡献的有意义的工作。 D) 我们做充分发挥我们能力的高要求工作。

questions.q: What does the author say we do in an ideal world?
options: We do work that betters the lives of our families and friends.
We do work that gives us bursts of joy each new day.
We do meaningful work that contributes to society.
We do demanding work that brings our capacity into full play.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author say we do in an ideal world 限定在 ideal world 这一条件下 询问具体做法，是单点细节复述。

【拆句】主干 What does the author say we do，we do 是宾语从句省略 that，in an ideal world 是地点状语；句式直白。 53. What does the author say we do in an ideal world? A) We do work that betters the lives of our families and friends. B) We do work that gives us bursts of joy each new day. C) We do meaningful work that contributes to society. D) We do demanding work that brings our capacity into full play.

【定位】In the ideal world, we're all doing work that we're proud of and that provides meaning and purpose to us. But even if your job doesn't give you shivers of joy each new day, working is a part of what each of us does and the contribution we make to society. 在理想世界里，我们都在做让自己自豪、能为我们提供意义与目的的工作。但即便你的工作 不会让你每天都因喜悦而颤抖，工作仍是我们每个人所做的事情之一，是我们对社会做出的 贡献。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 选项说工作让「家人与朋友」的生活变得更好，原文说的是 the contribution we make to society——贡献对象是「社会」，不是「家人与朋友」；且 support … our families, and the people around us 是讲「养活」，不是「理想世界中的工作 内容」。 B) 与原文相反 原文 even if your job doesn't give you shivers of joy each new day 用 even if 引导 让步：即便工作不带来 shivers of joy，工作也仍是贡献——意味着作者承认「很多人的 工作并不带来 shivers of joy」，选项却把「带来 shivers of joy」说成「理想世界的状 态」，与原文意图相反。 C) ✓ 正确 provides meaning and purpose to us ↔meaningful work the contribution we make to society ↔contributes to society We do meaningful work that contributes to society 同时打中「有意义的工作」和 「对社会有贡献」两个语义点，与定位句两层并列对应。 D) 无中生有 选项说「做让我们能力全开的高难度工作」，原文谈的是工作的「意义、目的、对社会 贡献」，从未涉及工作难度或能力发挥维度。 作者关于生活说了什么? A) 它是循环的。 B) 它是动态的。 C) 它是充实的。 D) 它是有风险的。

questions.q: What does the author say about life?
options: It is cyclical.
It is dynamic.
It is fulfilling.
It is risky.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about life 与第 52 题同款句式，问作者对 life 这个对象的明确 陈述。

【拆句】What does the author say about life 一句话主谓宾齐全，无从句、无否定，无陷阱。 54. What does the author say about life? A) It is cyclical. B) It is dynamic. C) It is fulfilling. D) It is risky.

【定位】These variations are normal, and it's more useful to think of life as something that is ever evolving and changing, rather than a high-risk enterprise where things could go wrong with one misstep. 这些变化都是正常的，把人生看作不断演变、不断变化的事物，比把它看成「一步错就全盘 崩」的高风险事业更有益。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 选项说生活是「循环往复」的，原文说的是「不断演变与变化」——演变是单向推进， 循环是周期回到原点，两者方向不同。 B) ✓ 正确 ever evolving and changing ↔It is dynamic These variations are normal ↔It is dynamic It is dynamic 用「动态的」一词总括了原文 ever evolving、changing、variations 等 同一语义场词汇，符合作者对 life 的定性。 C) 张冠李戴 选项说生活是「充实的」——但原文 provides meaning and purpose 修饰的是 work，不是 life；本题问的是作者对 life 的看法。 D) 与原文相反 选项说生活是「有风险的」，但原文 rather than a high-risk enterprise where things could go wrong with one misstep 中的 rather than（而不是）正是要否定「高风 险」这种看法——作者主张的恰恰是 life 不是 high-risk。 作者建议我们做什么? A) 让生活尽可能简单。 B) 用更简单的方式谈论平衡。 C) 以一种新的方式平衡生活和工作。 D) 追求更充实的生活。

questions.q: What does the author advise us to do?
options: Make life as simple as possible.
Talk about balance in simpler terms.
Balance life and work in a new way.
Strive for a more fulfilling life.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author advise us to do 不指向某段细节，而问作者贯穿全文给读者的最终 主张，落在末段总结句，本质是主旨或态度类问题。

【拆句】What does the author advise us to do，主干 the author advise us，to do 是不定式宾 语补足语，结构平直。 55. What does the author advise us to do? A) Make life as simple as possible. B) Talk about balance in simpler terms. C) Balance life and work in a new way. D) Strive for a more fulfilling life.

【选项】A) 无中生有 选项说让生活「尽可能简单」，原文从未谈过 simple 或 simplicity——作者主张的是 「更宏大美好的 fulfillment」，与「简化」无关。 B) 以偏概全 选项把作者的呼吁缩到「用更简单的措辞谈论 balance」，但作者主张的是「抛弃 balance、转向 fulfillment」，不是「换种说法继续谈 balance」。 C) 与原文相反 选项说「用新方式平衡工作与生活」，但作者末段明确 Let's bury "work-life balance"——要埋葬 balance，而不是用新方式继续 balance。 D) ✓ 正确 think bigger and better about work-life fulfillment ↔Strive for a more fulfilling life a lot more living ↔a more fulfilling life Strive for a more fulfilling life 用 strive for 对接末段 think bigger and better about，用 a more fulfilling life 对接 work-life fulfillment 加 a lot more living—— 选项准确覆盖全文呼吁的两个核心词 fulfillment 与 living。
